mentions.name: Tickerfeed
mentions.description: A web platform at tickerfeed.net for creating blog posts, equipped with moderation tools. Recent development work includes improved moderation tooling, a rewrite of an upstream client to move off a deprecated API, CSS/UI improvements, and bug fixes.
